details: Sauer--Shelah bound. The full cube gives an unbounded reverse-linear separation: $\mathrm{VC}=n$ while $\mathrm{LSR}=\Theta(n/\log n)$.
proof: Let $d=\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$ and let $n$ be the domain size.  Sauer--Shelah gives $|\mathcal H|\le\sum_{i=0}^{d}\binom ni\le(n+1)^d$.  Therefore $d\ge\log(|\mathcal H|)/\log(n+1)$, which is the asserted bound up to the harmless $-1$ normalization in Log Size Ratio.
name: VC Dimension / Log Size Ratio
